prompt:
Goal: Create a cozy overhead photograph of an open illustrated creative notebook spread on a warm wooden desk, showing a delicate watercolor anime character design study for a shy summer girl.

Canvas: Square 1:1 composition, realistic photo of a sketchbook lying open, soft morning sunlight, warm shadows, shallow natural depth, tactile paper texture, slightly aged cream pages, center gutter visible.

Main notebook spread: The right page is dominated by one large pastel watercolor anime illustration of a young girl with long sandy blonde hair, large pale aqua-green eyes, flushed cheeks, and a wistful expression. She leans with her arms in shallow water, wearing a soft blue gingham or pale blue summer garment, with wet hair strands flowing across the page. She wears a wide straw sunhat decorated with exactly 3 visible flower groups: one large yellow sunflower on the upper right of the hat, one cluster of small white flowers near the top center-left, and a smaller white floral cluster near the brim. Add delicate ink linework, translucent washes, tiny sparkles, water ripples, and paint blooms.

Left page contents: Make the left page look like an artist’s concept notebook with exactly 6 discrete study elements: 1 small close-up eye sketch with aqua iris, 1 tiny round color/detail sketch near it, 1 small back-view portrait of the girl’s hair and flower accessory, 1 small square fabric/pattern swatch with pale blue flowers, 1 row of exactly 5 pastel color swatches at the bottom in muted yellow, peach, mint green, pale blue, and dusty blue, and 1 small simple flower doodle beside the notes. Include light handwritten Japanese-style annotations in pencil/gray ink, including short notes about sunflowers, white flowers, glossy wet light, soft wind, cute texture, small floral reflections on the water surface, and beautiful sky-and-sea colors.

Right page details: Add a pale blue gingham tape patch at the upper right corner, a small blue water ripple doodle near the lower center, and a torn paper note taped at the lower right with handwritten Japanese text about carefully drawing the sparkling water surface and sunflower light. A partial sunflower peeks from the lower right edge of the notebook.

Desk props: Surround the notebook with exactly 8 visible stationery/desk items: 1 floral fabric pencil pouch with a brass zipper at the top left, 1 pale blue marker labeled Soft Blue near the top center, 1 roll of blue polka-dot washi tape at the top right, 1 mint-and-beige marker at the bottom left, 1 pale pink marker at the bottom left, 1 small torn watercolor test paper with blue and mint paint marks at the bottom center, 1 light blue marker at the bottom center-right, and 1 white pen at the bottom right. Add a few dried white flowers along the right edge and small torn patterned papers, but keep them secondary.

Visual style: Hyper-detailed realistic flat-lay photography combined with ethereal Japanese watercolor illustration; airy pastel palette of cream, honey wood, soft blue, mint, peach, sunflower yellow, and pale beige. Emphasize handmade sketchbook texture, transparent pigment granulation, pencil construction lines, loose ink strokes, masking tape, torn paper edges, and gentle sunlight.

Constraints: Use only one open notebook spread, keep the illustration and notes integrated into the paper rather than floating digitally, preserve the count of study elements and desk items, avoid printed UI elements or modern screens, no watermark, no extra characters.

promptZh:
目标：在温暖的木质桌面上创作一张温馨的俯拍照片，展示一本打开的创意插画笔记本，内页展示精美的动漫角色水彩设计习作，角色为 一位害羞的夏日女孩。

画面：1:1 正方形构图，写生本平铺的写实摄影，柔和的晨光，温暖的阴影，自然的浅景深，真实的纸张质感，略显陈旧的米色页面，可见中间装订线。

笔记本主页：右侧页面以一幅大型柔和水彩动漫插画为主，描绘了一位拥有 长长的沙金色头发、淡水绿色大眼睛、红润脸颊和忧郁表情的少女。她双臂倚在浅水中，身穿柔软的蓝白格纹或淡蓝色夏装，湿润的发丝散落在页面上。她戴着一顶宽大的草帽，上面装饰着 3 组清晰可见的花朵：帽檐右上角有一朵大向日葵，顶部中左侧有一簇小白花，帽檐附近有一簇较小的白色花朵。加入精致的墨水线条、半透明水彩晕染、细小的闪光、水波纹和颜料扩散效果。

左侧页面内容：将左侧页面设计为艺术家的概念笔记本，包含 6 个独立的习作元素：1 个带有水绿色虹膜的眼睛特写草图，其附近有 1 个微小的圆形颜色/细节草图，1 个女孩头发和花朵配饰的背面肖像小图，1 个带有淡蓝色花朵图案的方形织物/纹样样本，底部有 1 排共 5 个柔和色块（分别为柔黄色、桃色、薄荷绿、淡蓝色和灰蓝色），以及笔记旁边的 1 个简单的花朵涂鸦。包含铅笔或灰色墨水书写的日式手写注释，内容涉及向日葵、白花、光泽湿润的光感、柔风、可爱的质感、水面上的细小花朵倒影以及美丽的蓝天大海色调。

右侧页面细节：右上角贴有一块淡蓝色格纹胶带，下部中心附近有一个蓝色水波纹涂鸦，右下角贴有一张撕下的纸条，上面用日文手写着关于仔细描绘波光粼粼的水面和向日葵光影的笔记。笔记本右下边缘露出半朵向日葵。

桌面道具：在笔记本周围摆放 8 件可见的文具/桌面用品：左上角有一个带黄铜拉链的花卉布艺笔袋，顶部中心附近有一支标签为 Soft Blue 的淡蓝色马克笔，右上角有一卷蓝色波点纸胶带，左下角有一支薄荷色配米色的马克笔，左下角有一支淡粉色马克笔，底部中心有一张撕下的带有蓝绿色颜料痕迹的水彩试色纸，底部中右侧有一支浅蓝色马克笔，右下角有一支白色中性笔。右侧边缘点缀几朵干白花和撕碎的图案纸，但保持次要地位。

视觉风格：超细节的写实平铺摄影与空灵的日式水彩插画相结合；采用米色、蜂蜜木色、柔蓝色、薄荷色、桃色、向日葵黄和浅米色的空气感柔和色调。强调手工写生本的质感、透明颜料的颗粒感、铅笔构图线、随性的墨水笔触、美纹纸胶带、撕裂的纸张边缘以及柔和的阳光。

约束条件：仅使用一个打开的笔记本页面，确保插画和笔记与纸张融为一体，而非数字浮层，保留习作元素和桌面物品的数量，避免出现打印的 UI 元素或现代屏幕，无水印，无多余角色。
